sp: Warm, intimate string quartet instrumental. 72 BPM, 3/4 time, key of D major. Two violins carry a flowing legato melody in close counterpoint, a viola fills warm inner harmony, and a cello sustains a gentle foundation with soft pizzicato accents. The lead violin sings the main theme with expressive vibrato, answered by the second violin in warm call-and-response. The arrangement opens sparse and intimate, then swells into a lush full-quartet crescendo at the center before settling into a delicate, hushed close. Gentle rubato phrasing and light pizzicato mark the lilt. Cinematic and celebratory yet gentle — a wedding piece dedicated to the bride. Warm, close, resonant room ambience, instrumental with no vocals.
